courses.title: 1:1 Trauma-Informed Life & Healing Coaching
courses.description: Weekly one-to-one coaching sessions with Julie Skon, offered as three-, six- or twelve-month packages and starting with a free 30-minute call. Sessions combine space to process what you are carrying with structure and accountability, with themes such as trauma healing through a mind-body lens, grief and life transitions, goals and leadership.
courses.price: $2,100 (3 months, 12 sessions); $4,100 (6 months, 24 sessions); $7,800 (1 year, 48 sessions)
